en.headline: He Lifeng and John Lee address Global Financial Leaders’ Investment Summit
en.dek: Vice-Premier pledged continued support for Hong Kong as a free open financial centre and more offshore yuan liquidity; Lee said the five-year plan offers investors certainty.
body: The Global Financial Leaders’ Investment Summit held its main sessions in Hong Kong on Tuesday, gathering about 280 leaders from the sector including around 120 group chairpersons and chief executives.

Vice-Premier He Lifeng, speaking by video link, said China would continue to support a free and open economic environment in Hong Kong and boost offshore yuan liquidity. He described the development of the city as remaining a key strategy for China and pledged full support for its long-term development and stability. He indicated plans to expand yuan-denominated bond issuance in Hong Kong and support listings there.

Chief Executive John Lee, addressing the gathering in person, said Hong Kong could offer certainty, clarity and confidence to global investors at a time of structural change in finance. He noted that the city’s first five-year blueprint laid out a transparent roadmap and that the value proposition under one country, two systems remained intact. Lee said he would attend the Apec Economic Leaders’ Meeting in Shenzhen later this month.
The three-day event is hosted by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority and continues through Wednesday with discussions on macroeconomic trends, financial markets and technology.

zh.headline: 何立峰與李家超在國際金融領袖投資峰會致辭
zh.dek: 副總理表示將繼續支持香港作為自由開放金融中心並增加離岸人民幣流動性；李家超指五年規劃為投資者提供確定性。
body: 國際金融領袖投資峰會周二在香港舉行主峰會，約280位業界領袖出席，包括約120位集團主席及行政總裁。
國務院副總理何立峰透過視像致辭，表示中國將繼續支持香港保持自由開放的經濟環境，並提升離岸人民幣流動性。他指建設香港仍是國家重要戰略，承諾全力支持其長期發展與穩定，並提及將擴大在港發行人民幣債券及支持上市。
行政長官李家超親身致辭，表示在全球金融結構轉變之際，香港可為投資者提供確定性、清晰度和信心。他指本港首份五年規劃提供透明路線圖，一國兩制下的價值主張保持不變，並表示本月將出席在深圳舉行的亞太經合組織經濟領袖會議。
這場由香港金融管理局主辦的三日活動將持續至周三，討論宏觀經濟趨勢、金融市場及科技發展。
